zh: 修复第三方插件挂在侧栏页脚的对话框被接管隐藏、打开成模态框后整页失去响应的问题：自身是浮层的页脚条目不再收进账号菜单，皮肤也不向它写入 display。
en: Fix the whole page going unresponsive when a dialog a plugin mounts into the sidebar footer was hidden by the takeover: a footer entry that is itself a floating overlay is no longer collected into the account menu, and the skin writes no display rule onto it.
